# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `rephraseai` MCP server pointing at Rephrase AI's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://www.rephraseai.com/cursor/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth sign-in to Rephrase AI — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: references `https://www.rephraseai.com/icon0.svg`; no local file yet because the site was unreachable when the plugin was added.
